description: One complete recipe record. One complete recipe record from the Ni Biashara recipes shelf: ingredients with quantities and units, timed steps, substitutions that work, sourcing notes and pairing. Query by record id or exact dish title. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

id.description: recipe record id, e.g. kenyan-beef-pilau (this or title required)

title.description: dish title, exact or close match (this or id required)
